title: RDK-B Core Broadband CPU Utilization by Process
description: Per-profile CPU utilization by process, answering 'what consumes the CPU minimum'. Sibling file to memory-footprint.schema.json and flash-layout.schema.json, kept separate from hw-compat.schema.json so utilization data can be added as components are profiled without touching the CPU/RAM/flash/peripheral spec file.

specVersion.description: Version of this JSON schema (semantic version), e.g. "1.0".

profileId.description: Matches the profileId in the corresponding hw-compat.schema.json file for this profile.

measured.description: True if CPU utilization has been measured on a reference device for at least one process; false if this profile is pending profiling.

referenceDevice.description: Optional. Device the measurement was taken on, e.g. "BPI-R4 (MediaTek MT7988, Filogic)".

measurementCondition.description: Optional. What state the device was in when measured, e.g. "idle, no active clients" or "steady-state, 4 Wi-Fi clients, 500 Mbps WAN throughput". CPU utilization is highly workload-dependent, so this matters as much as the numbers.

lastMeasured.description: Optional. ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the most recent measurement pass.

totalCpuPercent.description: Optional. Aggregate CPU utilization (%, summed across cores) across all processes at the measurement condition above.

processes.description: Per-process CPU utilization entries, typically sorted descending. Empty when measured is false.

cpuPercent.description: CPU utilization in percent (of one core) at the stated measurement condition, or "TBD" if not yet measured.

componentRepo.description: Optional. RDK-B Component List repo name for cross-reference.

othersCpuPercent.description: Optional. Aggregate CPU utilization for remaining processes not individually broken out.

notes.description: Optional. Free-text notes, e.g. explaining measurement methodology or why a profile is unmeasured.
